qualification: Exactly two malformed quoted token spans are replaced by raw OCR byte slices corroborated in the same 1903 printing native page and matching full-page/context TSV boxes. Every other source byte, punctuation, whitespace and LF boundary remains exact. No general proofreading, translation, lexical modernization or whole-source collation.
python3_program:
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib,json,sys,zipfile,io,csv
H=lambda b:hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()
r=json.loads(Path(sys.argv[1]).read_text());b=Path(r["source"]["path"]).read_bytes();assert H(b)==r["source"]["sha256"],"source hash"
e=Path(r["evidence"]["path"]).read_bytes();assert H(e)==r["evidence"]["sha256"],"evidence hash"
z=zipfile.ZipFile(io.BytesIO(e));w=json.loads(z.read("witness.json"))
for n,v in w["members"].items():assert H(z.read(n))==v["sha256"],"evidence member hash"
last=0
for q in r["changes"]:
 a,c=q["start"],q["end"];assert last<=a<c<=len(b);last=c
 assert b[a:c].hex()==q["before_hex"],"old token span"
 left=bytes.fromhex(q["left_context_hex"]);right=bytes.fromhex(q["right_context_hex"])
 assert b[a-len(left):a]==left and b[c:c+len(right)]==right,"source context"
 v=z.read(q["replacement_member"]);i,j=q["replacement_byte_range"];replacement=v[i:j];assert replacement.hex()==q["replacement_hex"],"OCR byte slice"
 i,j=q["context_ocr_byte_range"];assert v[i:j].hex()==q["context_ocr_hex"],"OCR context"
 i,j=q["full_page_ocr_context_byte_range"];assert z.read("page-ocr.txt")[i:j].hex()==q["context_ocr_hex"],"full-page agreement"
 for member,key in (("context-ocr.tsv","crop_tsv_row"),("page-ocr.tsv","full_page_tsv_row")):
  rows=list(csv.DictReader(io.StringIO(z.read(member).decode()),delimiter="\t"));assert q[key] in rows and q[key]["text"].encode()==replacement and float(q[key]["conf"])>95,"TSV token box"
out=b
for q in reversed(r["changes"]):
 i,j=q["replacement_byte_range"];v=z.read(q["replacement_member"])[i:j];out=out[:q["start"]]+v+out[q["end"]:]
assert H(out)==r["output_sha256"] and len(out)==r["output_byte_size"],"output hash/extent"
assert out.count(b"\n")==b.count(b"\n"),"LF count"
Path(sys.argv[2]).write_bytes(out)
